topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I heard my neighbor’s son, who left for the big city to study, had his words shown to all. His college words, the ones he poured over by candlelight, nowLine break are read by strangers. I can hardly think of what it means, having your private thoughts hung out for the world to see. It makes me hold tighter to my secrets, like I do with the seed corn before sowing. I wonder if he feels the same, or if the city folk are not so troubled by such things. I’ll pray to the saints for his peace, and for mine, that our words and thoughts might stay where they belong, safe and unseen.
